# bcdec_rs

The native daemon links `bcdec_rs` 0.2.0 (MIT), a Rust port of the `bcdec`
block-compression decoder (MIT). The published crate contains no license
file, so `LICENSE.txt` holds the MIT license text with the copyright holders
of both projects: the crate's author (ScanMountGoat, from its package
metadata) and the author of `bcdec` (Sergii Kudlai). Packaging copies it into
`resources/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.
